acceptanceCriteria: A1: Planner cost estimates expose planned executed reusable resource and parallelism dimensions without changing the selected verification tier or policy decision
A2: Execution observations report single Work Item and parallel multi-node cost metrics with repository and Runtime identity
A3: Cost confidence remains explicit and unknown or partial measurements never become a green governance result
A4: Reuse and affected verification reductions are observable as cost facts and cannot authorize skipping protected or policy-required nodes
A5: No hard performance target is presented as assurance and no Tier or EvidenceAssurance value is inferred from speed
A6: Tri-language documentation defines Verification cost as advisory and preserves the principle Verification Truth before Verification Cost
goal: Measure single-WI and parallel verification cost so future optimization can reduce execution work while preserving VerificationTier EvidenceAssurance and protected gates.
intent: Expose identity-bound Verification cost estimates and observations without allowing performance heuristics to weaken governance requirements.
outOfScope: Changing policy planner decisions or protected gate execution
CI YAML policy removal or release performance targets

scenarioCoverage.expected: A complete identity-bound observation reports planned executed elapsed and resource facts without changing governance state.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run a one-node verification and assert the cost projection and receipt observation fields.

scenarioCoverage.scenario: parallel multi-node and reuse cost observation
scenarioCoverage.expected: Parallelism and reuse reductions are visible while protected and policy-required nodes remain executed.
scenarioCoverage.verificationPlan: Run independent nodes with workers greater than one plus a reusable receipt and assert advisory-only metrics.
